subject.title: Fix Codex fork identity and cache invalidation

question: Should maintainers land this actively maintained original branch, prefer the overlapping https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2120, or consolidate both with compatible ancestry work from https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2113?
rationale: Two proof-positive branches carry substantially the same central fix, their contributors disagree about supersession, and an adjacent ancestry PR modifies the same accounting path; automation cannot safely choose ownership or integration order.

options.title: Land This Original Branch
options.body: Compare the three current heads, add any uniquely useful ancestry coverage, and land this active original implementation while preserving its existing attribution.

options.title: Prefer The Cherry-Picked Branch
options.body: Land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2120 only if maintainers confirm it contains every current optimization and test from this PR and provides the preferred review history.

options.title: Create A Consolidated Landing Branch
options.body: Pause both duplicate candidates and combine the accepted identity, cache-dependency, and ancestry changes into one maintainer-owned integration branch.

recommendation.title: Land This Original Branch
recommendation.body: Compare the three current heads, add any uniquely useful ancestry coverage, and land this active original implementation while preserving its existing attribution.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership makes this person the best available owner for choosing between disputed overlapping landing branches.
